# High Roller Technologies Launches ROLR™ Apple iOS Mobile App, Expanding Access for Its Prediction Markets Platform to Apple iPhone Users


November 09, 2026 8:18 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_abc38f8ff4e1773c1b9179b2f0c972a0/highroller/news/2026-11-09_High_Roller_Technologies_Launches_ROLR_Apple_iOS_174.pdf)


*Available through the Apple App Store and ROLR.com, the app brings market discovery, trading and account management to customers’ mobile devices*


*Mobile launch supports ROLR’s customer-acquisition strategy in a U.S. market with an estimated 150 million iPhone users, which is part of a worldwide base of over 1.5 billion iPhone users*


LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[High Roller Technologies, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=F6blt-Fa7DRymRiuJG8U_Szjx98aRS3qtQXscXC0s4qArhHeg3Bja6FpjAke2jSfuzGCNqE7LY52GXzS_bGvFMfiqCUDERMyAUAnPwV2r-8=) (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced the launch of the ROLR™ mobile app, now available for download through the[Apple App Store](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=EA3YfQnFe8wv5GptdRvX_4w6abFF1PBFWSLRjE2pmpOB8Gqm8b2DGvVKeBSB45d3Bmo9qD5zcapMyZ3OeOqm9D_zLVzVCx7zdDWJSwjOuog=) and at[ROLR.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=E8yUs6JNOh3vLqjiOwivgQJHB_Vi1yRdohBWuFzAaETu3iGZZKcUcpVZdfVrz6BUvuNZ5h7wUzWTOZP3CgcpYA==) . The app gives eligible U.S. customers convenient mobile access to ROLR’s real-money prediction markets platform, allowing them to explore markets, trade event-based contracts and manage their accounts on the go.


The mobile app builds on ROLR’s recent commercial launch and expands the ways customers can participate in markets tied to sports, politics, economics, cryptocurrency, culture and other real-world events.


“Launching the ROLR mobile app puts our platform directly in customers’ hands, making it easier to discover markets, act on their views and manage their positions wherever they are eligible to trade,” said Seth Young, Chief Executive Officer of High Roller Technologies. “We believe a convenient, intuitive mobile experience is an important part of attracting new customers and keeping them engaged. This launch gives our marketing and distribution partners another way to introduce audiences to ROLR and supports our strategy to build a growing prediction markets business.”


The ROLR mobile app brings core platform capabilities into a dedicated mobile experience, including:


- **Market discovery:** Browse available event-based contracts across multiple categories and find markets tied to topics of interest.
- **Mobile trading:** Review available contracts and pricing, enter orders and trade based on views about real-world outcomes.
- **Position management:** Monitor open positions and review trading activity and contract settlement.
- **Registration and account funding:** Complete account registration, identity verification and required eligibility checks, fund an account and request withdrawals.
- **Customer support:** Access assistance with account, funding and trading-related questions.


**ROLR iOS App Available for Immediate Download**


The ROLR iOS app is now available to eligible U.S. customers. Eligible customers can download the app directly to their iPhone from the[Apple App Store](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=EA3YfQnFe8wv5GptdRvX_-acdWrMXK9Xm8Jq51lajOTuj6aAQ2esyURRhoPv3yD3bnBXgKmNX3HNqiFfmrO6Wi6w-7VD69jRBbI4wzG0bU4=)[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=IJ9ZCso0WB_saUmnV5GZahW98QJAuH2oqWNpbdWYWe9swUaewaas5DerVkIC8LO4D7DQeJrNGHZS__bukwEDXEH2E4bDXxLNcOufPM2Vmew0daAJWgzBxlsvlCuIfblce0lHzEUE3zCk7wUm49OZtA==) and from[ROLR.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=E8yUs6JNOh3vLqjiOwivgeggcRiqkqV0VekZjKtrsM4GQcIoVQQ2divWG_XAd0nDv-0EWc4cyHRsHllD8WZiBg==) . Access and contract availability are subject to applicable eligibility requirements and geographic restrictions.


High Roller’s wholly owned subsidiary, ROLR US LLC, is a member of the National Futures Association and a registered guaranteed introducing broker operating under a guarantee agreement with OG Markets US, Inc., doing business as Crypto.com FCM. Customer accounts introduced through ROLR are carried by Crypto.com FCM; ROLR US LLC does not hold customer funds.


The platform incorporates technology provided through High Roller’s exclusive license and development agreement with mrkts.com, including a source code license and connectivity to Crypto.com services and CDNA, along with payments and compliance functionality. High Roller owns the customer-facing ROLR application, with the licensing framework providing flexibility to evolve the platform while retaining control over its customer experience and product roadmap.


The launch establishes a dedicated mobile presence for ROLR within the widely used iPhone ecosystem. Published industry estimates put U.S. iPhone users at approximately 150 million in 2025 and the worldwide active iPhone base at roughly 1.5 billion to 1.6 billion.1 Separately,[Apple reported in January 2026](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=EA3YfQnFe8wv5GptdRvX_72WxOibIzQyogXsAkmv4jwW7ZtVaFjxjjpe1euK4km3Rl3C1ukBf3pQASwFkYw9-XaCycdUVddanPE-ZxO-XxtbqwRIU0Vw97kaRyuVPSjSRm6jR9l8-wnGKopIRcnk6FkMziBv4E6CuHYavKO5Wn39jkq1Eiz0XPXSc0XRoYsIfchB2OxQT8uNgrQ_0pFuew==) that its installed base exceeded 2.5 billion active devices across all product categories. These figures provide context for the scale of the ecosystem; ROLR’s availability remains limited to eligible U.S. customers in permitted jurisdictions.


**Trading Risk Disclosure**


Trading event contracts involves significant risk and is not appropriate for everyone. Customers may lose the full amount committed to a transaction, including fees. Customers must be at least 18 years old and meet applicable eligibility requirements. Geographic restrictions apply.
